mutants.description: Silence the critical endpoint alert during a planned deployment instead of the warning alert.
mutants.contract: Deployments may suppress the two-minute public endpoint warning, but the five-minute critical alert must remain active.

mutants.description: Expire the maintenance silence immediately after Compose convergence while verification is still running.
mutants.contract: The planned warning silence must remain active until post-deployment verification succeeds.

mutants.description: Treat an account as SSO-only when either provider field is present instead of requiring a complete provider identity.
mutants.contract: Only users with both authProvider and providerSubject are SSO-only; partially migrated local accounts must retain password reset.

mutants.description: Apply both username and IP limits to authenticated email/QR calls after a defense-in-depth refactor.
mutants.contract: Authenticated email and QR calls use the user policy; IP is the fallback only when identity is unavailable.

mutants.description: Read stock without a pessimistic product lock, allowing competing checkouts to validate the same final unit.
mutants.contract: Checkout must serialize product validation and deduction so one final unit produces one order and a stable HTTP 409 for the loser.

mutants.description: Persist the order and deduct each line while validation is still in progress, then commit a stock conflict.
mutants.contract: A multi-line checkout is atomic: one unavailable line leaves every stock quantity, movement, order, and cart unchanged.

mutants.description: Allow cancellation of an already-cancelled order and leave its inventory state deducted so compensation runs again.
mutants.contract: Cancellation restores deducted stock exactly once and transitions the internal inventory state to RESTORED.

mutants.description: Clear one-time PKCE state before the remote token exchange rather than after a successful response.
mutants.contract: A transient exchange failure must leave callback state available for a safe retry.

mutants.description: Parse only the latest network chunk and overwrite an incomplete buffered SSE event.
mutants.contract: SSE event boundaries are independent of transport chunk boundaries; incomplete events must be retained.

mutants.description: Generalize automatic training SSO activation from the gateway origin to every loopback port.
mutants.contract: Implicit training SSO is enabled only on the designated localhost:8081 gateway, never on unrelated loopback applications.

mutants.description: Generate a new adjustment request ID after a rejected attempt, turning an operator retry into a new inventory intent.
mutants.contract: A failed or ambiguous inventory adjustment retains its UUID so retrying the unchanged form is idempotent; only success or a new selected-product intent rotates it.

mutants.description: Use the ordinary token delay for tool calls, collapsing two latency policies during cleanup.
mutants.contract: Tool-call chunks use toolCallDelay; textual chunks use tokenDelay; completion is immediate.

mutants.description: Resolve a multi-turn conversation from the first meaningful message rather than its latest message.
mutants.contract: Tool scenarios advance according to the latest meaningful user/tool message.

mutants.description: Keep only the short JMS type identifier and silently remove the legacy producer FQCN alias.
mutants.contract: The consumer accepts both EmailDTO and com.awesome.testing.dto.email.EmailDTO type identifiers during migration.

mutants.description: Use an unscoped cart projection query.
mutants.contract: Each customer can read only their own cart; an administrator may explicitly select another owner.

mutants.description: Reuse the administrative order lookup for every authenticated user.
mutants.contract: A customer cannot read another customer’s order by ID; administrators can.

mutants.description: Require only authentication for the administrative inventory listing.
mutants.contract: Only administrators can query inventory management details; customer catalog availability remains shared.

mutants.description: A commerce operation with GraphQL errors must fail even when data is present.
mutants.contract: A commerce operation with GraphQL errors must fail even when data is present.

mutants.description: My orders must remain scoped to the current user, including administrators.
mutants.contract: My orders must remain scoped to the current user, including administrators.

mutants.description: Make the GraphQL execution endpoint public while enabling the GraphiQL shell.
mutants.contract: Only the GraphiQL editor GET is public; unauthenticated GraphQL requests must return HTTP 401.

mutants.description: A customer must not access inventory RPCs.
mutants.contract: A customer must not access inventory RPCs.

mutants.description: Replaying a product-scoped request ID must not apply the stock change twice.
mutants.contract: Replaying a product-scoped request ID must not apply the stock change twice.

mutants.description: GraphQL traffic must omit raw documents, aliases, client operation names and literals.
mutants.contract: GraphQL traffic must omit raw documents, aliases, client operation names and literals.

mutants.description: Native traffic must store canonical status codes, never raw status descriptions.
mutants.contract: Native traffic must store canonical status codes, never raw status descriptions.

mutants.description: GraphQL errors remain errors even when HTTP status is 200.
mutants.contract: GraphQL errors remain errors even when HTTP status is 200.

mutants.description: The optional lightweight gRPC listener must not publish on public host interfaces.
mutants.contract: Training gRPC is available only on host loopback; the Compose toggle must not expose it on the network.

mutants.description: Native inventory gRPC must be exposed only on host loopback, not all interfaces.
mutants.contract: Production native gRPC is available through SSH tunnelling; public native listeners violate deployment isolation.

mutants.description: The disposable sandbox must not inherit the stable site JWT signing key.
mutants.contract: JWTs issued by either deployment must fail authentication at the other deployment.
Existing unprefixed MFA ciphertext must remain readable with the original derivation.
A traffic read must persist previously queued records before querying the database.

mutants.description: Take the migration rollback backup while old backends can still commit writes.
mutants.contract: The coordinated-upgrade rollback backup must be taken after both old backend instances stop and before app convergence.
Every NUL in every legacy preview must be normalized so immutable V6 can migrate repeated and boundary NULs.
Every JVM including the disposable sandbox must block the compromised CAs.
mutants.observableDifference: The sandbox JVM accepts a certificate rejected by the stable backend.

mutants.contract: Certificate-file updates must change the bind source so Compose recreates JVMs and remounts new inodes.
mutants.observableDifference: A later atomic file update leaves old running JVMs reading the old blocklist.

mutants.description: Simplify the OIDC decoder to the default issuer validator and lose the custom audience check.
mutants.contract: An SSO ID token is accepted only when it is signed by the trusted JWK set, issued by the configured issuer, unexpired, and addressed to the configured audience.
mutants.observableDifference: A correctly signed token issued for another client is accepted instead of returning HTTP 401.

mutants.description: Generalize legacy anonymous traffic access from the global topic to every traffic topic prefix.
mutants.contract: Legacy public access may open only /topic/traffic; per-browser-session topics always require an authenticated, bound session.
mutants.observableDifference: An anonymous STOMP client subscribes to another browser's /topic/traffic/<session> stream.

mutants.description: Treat X-Local-Outbox-Key as optional by validating it only when the header is supplied.
mutants.contract: When protected outbox access is enabled, every outbox read or clear requires an administrator and the exact configured access key.
mutants.observableDifference: An administrator without X-Local-Outbox-Key receives the outbox instead of HTTP 403.

mutants.description: Keep the sign-in guard on /admin/orders but drop its ADMIN role requirement.
mutants.contract: Every /admin route must render only for users with the ADMIN role; a signed-in client is sent home.
mutants.observableDifference: A client opening /admin/orders sees the admin orders page instead of being redirected to the home page.

mutants.description: Rename the email queue to 'emails' consistently across every backend profile, including the test profile.
mutants.contract: test-secure-backend publishes email events to the 'email' queue that jms-email-consumer listens on by default.

mutants.description: Serialize EmailDto.message as 'body' on the wire, as a REST-style naming cleanup.
mutants.contract: The JMS email payload carries to, subject, message, template and properties under the names the consumer's EmailDto binds.

mutants.description: Write the simple class name 'EmailDto' into the _awesome_ type header instead of the fully qualified name.
mutants.contract: The _awesome_ header carries a type identifier the consumer resolves to its EmailDto; the consumer maps only EmailDTO aliases and otherwise loads the FQCN.

mutants.description: Change the default listener destination to 'emails'.
mutants.contract: Without an ACTIVEMQ_DESTINATION override the consumer listens on the 'email' queue the backend publishes to.

mutants.description: Bind EmailDto.message from a 'body' JSON property.
mutants.contract: The consumer binds every producer payload field, including message, under the backend's names.

mutants.description: Read the JMS type identifier from a '_type' property instead of '_awesome_'.
mutants.contract: The consumer reads the type identifier from the _awesome_ header the backend writes.

mutants.description: Look up a checkout Idempotency-Key globally instead of per user, on the assumption that client keys are random UUIDs.
mutants.contract: Idempotency keys are scoped per user. Two users who send the same key each get their own order; a different user's key must never replay or conflict with someone else's checkout.

mutants.description: The sandbox warehouse-service must not read the stable warehouse runtime env file.
mutants.contract: Stable-site JWTs and the stable service token must not authenticate at the aitesters warehouse-service.

mutants.description: The aitesters host must route warehouse paths to its own warehouse-service.
mutants.contract: Warehouse requests on aitesters.byst.re reach aitesters-warehouse-service, never the stable warehouse-service.

mutants.description: The aitesters profile builds its schema with Hibernate create-drop instead of the Flyway migrations.
mutants.contract: Every packaged profile runs the production Flyway migrations and validates entities against them; no runtime profile lets Hibernate generate the schema.

mutants.description: The local email outbox becomes available whenever its flag is on, even with the JMS transport.
mutants.contract: Production (jms transport) never exposes the local email outbox endpoints or captures emails there.

mutants.description: The bootstrap admin runner runs although app.bootstrap-admin.enabled is false.
mutants.contract: With the runtime-gated runner, a disabled bootstrap admin must not touch users or fail startup.
